businesses.business: Industrial packaging and timber property management

offering_description.value: Greif manufactures industrial packaging for businesses across a range of industries. It produces bulk containers, flexible packaging, paperboard and packaging accessories, provides filling and packaging services, and manages timber properties.

quotes.quote: Greif is a global leader in packaging products and services and is pursuing its vision: be the best performing customer service company in the world. We produce steel, plastic and fibre drums, intermediate bulk containers, reconditioned containers, flexible products, containerboard, uncoated recycled paperboard, coated recycled paperboard, tubes and cores and a diverse mix of specialty products.

We also manufacture packaging accessories and provide filling, packaging and other services for a wide range of industries, along with managing timber properties in the southeastern United States. Greif is strategically positioned in multiple countries to serve customers of all sizes and needs.
